Job Responsibilities:

IW AEON Group Pty Ltd (Trading as Surrey Hills Tyre Power) (ABN 82 676 750 744)  are seeking an experienced and skilled Motor Mechanic to join our automotive repair team. 

The role involves diagnosing, servicing, repairing and testing motor vehicles, including cars, light commercial vehicles and 4WDs. The successful candidate may also be required to provide mobile mechanical and tyre-related services to customers when required. 

Key duties include:

-  Inspect and repair engines, transmissions, fuel systems, brakes, exhaust systems, suspension, and electrical systems for a wide range of vehicles, including cars, light trucks, and 4WDs.
-  Perform comprehensive mechanical repairs, including clutch and suspension work, wheel alignments, and brake repairs.
-  Diagnose and address auto-electrical issues such as battery problems and other modern electronic control systems using diagnostic equipment.
-  Carry out routine maintenance such as logbook servicing, tyre fitting, wheel balancing, and roadworthy and safety inspections to ensure compliance with industry and safety regulations.
-  Provide mobile tyre and mechanical repair services, performing diagnostics and repairs on-site for both commercial and personal vehicles.
-  Offer professional advice to customers regarding necessary repairs, presenting detailed explanations of mechanical issues and proposed solutions.
-  Maintain accurate service logs and ensure vehicles pass safety and performance tests after repair work.

Requirements:
-  Relevant automotive mechanical qualification is preferred, but equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
-  A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, with the ability to independently diagnose and repair vehicle issues.
-  Proficiency in using automotive diagnostic equipment and modern vehicle electronic control systems.
-  Excellent communication skills to provide detailed repair advice and technical support to customers.
-  A valid driver’s licence is preferred and may be required for carrying out mobile services.
-  Demonstrated commitment to ongoing full-time employment with the company.

Benefits:
-  Competitive salary: AUD $75,000-85,000 + super, negotiable depending on skills and experience.
-  Flexibility with mobile service work across various locations.
-  Opportunities for professional training and career development.
-  Be part of a dynamic team committed to delivering top-tier vehicle repair services.

Apply with a full resume via Work Force Australia.

LTD.     Hoppers Crossing VIC 3029    Salary: $79,000 - $85,000 per annum + Superannuation    Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time (40 hours per week)       Skills and Attributes   •    Ability to communicate in spoken and written English.  •    Strong knowledge of vehicle mechanical and electrical systems, diagnostics, and repair techniques.  •    Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.  •    Current Australian driver's licence with a good driving record.  •    Ability to work independently and manage mobile service appointments efficiently.  •    Ability to use diagnostic equipment and automotive repair tools.  •    Strong communication skills and a customer-focused attitude.     If you are a qualified and motivated  Mobile Mechanic/Motor Mechanic  looking to join a dynamic and growing team, we encourage you to apply. Click the Apply button to submit your application and become part of our professional team.   Benefits   Why join ACETUNE MECHANICS PTY. LTD.?   •    Competitive salary of $79,000 - $85,000 per annum, plus superannuation.  •    Permanent full-time position (40 hours per week).  •    Overtime opportunities and additional employee benefits.  •    Opportunity to join a growing business with a supportive team environment.   Task & responsibilities   Primary Objective:   This position is responsible for supporting the efficient operation of the company's mobile mechanical services by carrying out vehicle diagnostics, servicing, maintenance, and repairs. The role involves diagnosing and repairing engine, transmission, steering, suspension, braking, and electrical systems, conducting routine maintenance, and ensuring all work is completed to manufacturer specifications, Australian industry standards, and workplace health and safety requirements while delivering high-quality customer service.   Duties:   •    Travelling to customer locations using a fully equipped mobile service vehicle to perform mechanical servicing and repairs.  •    Conducting systematic inspections of petrol and diesel vehicles to identify mechanical and electrical faults.  •    Operating computerised diagnostic equipment and specialised testing instruments to accurately identify defects affecting vehicle performance.  •    Removing, dismantling and inspecting engines, transmissions, steering assemblies, braking systems, suspension components and other mechanical assemblies to determine the cause of faults.  •    Repairing or replacing worn, damaged or defective mechanical and electrical components using appropriate tools and manufacturer-approved repair procedures.  •    Reassembling engines and vehicle systems following repairs and ensuring all components are correctly fitted and securely installed.  •    Performing scheduled servicing including engine oil and filter replacement, lubrication, fluid replacement, tune-ups and preventative maintenance in accordance with manufacturers' specifications.  •    Carrying out post-repair testing, adjustments and quality checks to verify the safe and effective operation of repaired vehicles.  •    Responding to roadside breakdown call-outs and undertaking on-site fault diagnosis and repairs where practicable.  •    Advising customers regarding repair findings, maintenance requirements and recommended future repairs.  •    Maintaining accurate service records, repair reports and parts usage documentation.  •    Ensuring all work is completed in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements, environmental obligations and company quality standards.   Qualification & experience   Qualifications   •    Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology.  •    Certificate IV (or Equivalent)   Experience   •    At least three (3) years of relevant experience as a Motor Mechanic or Automotive Mechanic.  •    Experience in the automotive repair and servicing industry is preferred.
